papers.title: Intratumoral T cell activation kills tumors regardless of T cell specificity
papers.summary: Here the authors show that T cell activation within tumors triggers tumor clearance that is independent of tumor antigen recognition and occurs via a paracrine mechanism involving effector cytokines, nitric oxide, leukocyte recruitment and innate immune cells

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 作者在此指出，肿瘤内部的T细胞活化能够触发肿瘤清除过程，这一过程并不依赖于肿瘤抗原的识别，而是通过效应细胞因子、一氧化氮、白细胞募集以及先天免疫细胞的参与等旁分泌机制来实现的。
